scope: Targeted primary-source screening and theorem comparison. Sources available at search time with publication/version dates no later than the cutoff. Not an exhaustive bibliography or proof of absence.

source_records.title: New Analysis and Results for the Frank-Wolfe Method
source_records.checked: Method 1 steps 2-3, bound gap and warm-start discussion
source_records.conclusion: Best-so-far tangent bounds are prior, including the scalar accumulated stopping construction.

source_records.title: Beyond Short Steps in Frank-Wolfe Algorithms
source_records.checked: Sections 2-4, Proposition 4.1 and averaged lower models
source_records.conclusion: Computable primal-dual short steps and optimistic FW under global smoothness are prior; the displayed result uses a different update and certificate model.

source_records.title: Theoretical Analysis on how Learning Rate Warmup Accelerates Convergence
source_records.conclusion: Power-of-gap Hessian bounds precede the project. The lower bound concerns GD with non-increasing steps and gradient stationarity, not arbitrary convex FO algorithms.

source_records.title: Adaptive Lipschitz-Free Conditional Gradient Methods for Stochastic Composite Nonconvex Optimization
source_records.checked: PDF Section 3, Assumptions 1-3 and Definition 4; algorithm framework
source_records.conclusion: No-input-L and line-search-free adaptation is prior; component/average smoothness remains an assumption and the target is stochastic FW stationarity.

source_records.title: Beyond Polytopes: Damped Newton Frank-Wolfe Methods over Compact Convex Sets
source_records.checked: Section 1 positive-definite Hessian assumption and Sections 2-3 Newton/residual-backtracking framework
source_records.conclusion: Recent related second-order method; positive definite Hessians exclude the project's zero-base optimum where the Hessian is zero.

source_records.title: A Few Accelerated Algorithms for Convex Optimization under (H0,H1)-Smoothness
source_records.checked: Algorithm 2, discussion after Theorem 5, Appendix B Lemma 10
source_records.conclusion: Uses initial sublevel-set radius and distinguishes accelerated outer iterations from full inexact-relaxation oracle calls. Does not establish optimality against arbitrary FO methods.

source_records.title: Why Do We Need Warm-up? A Theoretical Perspective
source_records.checked: Version history, Appendix G Lemma 6, fixed-step GD lower-bound scope
source_records.conclusion: Same affine model and a looser global gradient bound are prior; fixed-step GD lower bounds do not imply the required all-method lower bound.

source_records.title: Frank-Wolfe Algorithms for (L0,L1)-smooth functions
source_records.checked: Version history; previously compared gradient-dependent model and stated Theorem 5.1
source_records.conclusion: The pre-cutoff v5 already belongs to the prior comparison; adaptation and generalized-smoothness FW are not new.

source_records.title: Adaptive Conditional Gradient Sliding: Projection-Free and Line-Search-Free Acceleration
source_records.checked: Version history; prior comparison of restart assumptions and inner LMO cost
source_records.conclusion: Accelerated outer gradient count is not the full inner LMO count; no superiority over sliding is established.

source_records.title: Auto-Conditioned Frank-Wolfe Algorithms
source_records.checked: Version history; prior charged-preprocessing comparator specification
source_records.conclusion: Unknown-curvature adaptation precedes the project; the native preprocessing and theorem assumptions must remain distinguished.

source_records.title: Adaptive Conditional Gradient Descent
source_records.checked: Version history; prior comparison of gradient-difference initialization and downward-lag discussion
source_records.conclusion: Slow downward adaptation is prior motivation, not a new observation.

source_records.title: Linearly Convergent Frank-Wolfe with Backtracking Line-Search
source_records.checked: PMLR publication record; arXiv v5 Theorems 3-4 and initialization
source_records.conclusion: Backtracking, total-trial accounting, averaged-gradient Fenchel duality and local-curvature AFW progress are prior.

source_records.title: Active Set Complexity of the Away-step Frank-Wolfe Algorithm
source_records.checked: Primary repository publication/update dates; previous Theorem 3.1 and generic-polytope comparison
source_records.conclusion: Finite active-set identification predates the project; only the zero-base specialization and explicit inherited-curvature cost remain specific claims.

source_records.title: Accelerated Stochastic Method under (H0,H1)-Smoothness and Heavy-Tailed Noise
source_records.conclusion: Related stochastic upper-bound extension; its abstract is not evidence of the deterministic information lower bound sought here.

source_records.title: Parameter-Agnostic Optimization under Relaxed Smoothness
source_records.conclusion: Lower bounds tailored to parameter-agnostic algorithms in gradient-dependent smoothness do not transfer automatically to the known-parameter model.

source_records.title: A general theory for exact sparse representation recovery in convex optimization
source_records.checked: Publisher dates, abstract and problem setup
source_records.conclusion: Sparse representation recovery under nondegenerate dual certificates; screened material does not state a backtracking-AFW update-complexity result.

limitations: Search-index absence is not proof of absence or priority.
Abstract-only screening is distinguished from theorem-level reading.
The JNVA DOI full text was unavailable; comparison stays with arXiv v5.
No citation counts are used as evidence that a niche is free.
The all-method H1 lower bound remains open in this project.
